paragraphs: Ravin bar Kisi, [Chullin 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.20b.4). Ravina bar Kisi, [Bava Batra 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.63a.3). Hyman says all three names refer to the same person.[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3206&lang=en) also records these name forms. The sources give each local reading; the identification is Hyman’s.
